material.description: Fact: the live page's Start match stays pre-match (0/10 ready) after Claim, Fill with bots and Start match. The start from loaded pack button navigates the tab to http://localhost:8790/js/client/play.html#moba, so no hero exists and the skills panel is never drawn. The skills panel is emitted by scenarios/moba/panels.lua:778 (side left) and mounted into #ui-left by js/client/widgets.js:10. Clearing action: a witness that reaches an in-match state at 375x667 (a hero on the live page, or a local pack server on a fixed port) and measures #ui-left>* against #ui-bar and #minimap, then closes device-phone-layout-overlap-375.
material.subject: Blocker: in-game skills panel at 375x667 cannot be reached from the live page in the sandbox
material.witness: Clearing action met: in-match state reached at 375x667 on the live local page (room joined in an isolated session, hero axe), #ui-left>* measured against #ui-bar and #minimap: no overlap. Witness dispatch 1792858975798-6011-78af689f4e4c4518 (session verify-device-phone-layout-overlap-375). Fix sha 6e6af37a6d3c3334d089bc16132234e29b526eac, CI success.
